onboarding.what: Signature scan during acquisition scores every known vendor; an unknown disk still gets entropy, codec and filesystem maps.
Vendor-agnostic recovery: DHAV today, raw H.264/H.265 next - footage out before any parser exists.
Recurring headers, self-describing length fields, date fields, codec and strings from samples; a before/after block-map diff.
One file in plugins/: signatures + a parser on the SDK. Loaded automatically; cannot open a device for writing.
Byte-match recovered footage against the recorder's own export. Only this moves a vendor to 'validated'.
